name: Tavernier Resources Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Tavernier Resources Ltd is in the business of trading in gems and jewellery.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) TRL is engaged in dealing and trading 
in gems and jewellery in India and abroad. 
b) It mainly exports cut & polished diamonds. 
c) The company is also engaged in trading of shares & securities. 
d) It also deals with real estate activities

cons: Stock is trading at 4.44 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -40.8% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 12.8% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.61 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 365 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -17.8%
Working capital days have increased from 846 days to 2,541 days
